data.title: What Happens if Bitcoin Falls Below $65,000?
data.description: Bitcoin is hovering just above a line that miners, ETF investors, and the world's biggest corporate holder all watch closely. Three support levels stand between a bounce and a deeper slide, and analysts disagree sharply on where the floor sits.
